story_type: three men on a capsized hull in open water, life ring and line to a rescue boat
hook: Their boat flipped 11 miles out. All three climbed on top.
narration: Three men sat on their flipped boat, eleven miles out in Lake Michigan.
Their first cell phone call let the 911 center pin down where they were.
By luck, a Coast Guard boat crew was training in the area.
They threw a life ring and told the first man to swim for it.
A ring on a line lets the crew pull a swimmer in without bringing the boat and its propellers close.
Then they hauled him up over the side.
That left two men on the hull, then one.
The last man let go and swam for the ring.
[short pause] All three had worn life jackets and stayed with the boat.
outcome: The crew brought all three to the station, where they declined medical care and were released.

location_card.place: Lake Michigan, off Lake Forest, Illinois

title: Flipped hull 11 miles out, 3 men on top
description:
A boat crew from Coast Guard Station Wilmette Harbor rescues three men from a capsized boat 11 nautical miles east of Lake Forest, Illinois, in Lake Michigan on June 5, 2016.
